'''June 2001 Billings tournament (10 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Billings, Montana on 10 June 2001. It is known from Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2428">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-10-montana-6-10-01d2428/ montana-6-10-01], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 10 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-10-montana-6-10-01d2428/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Billings, Montana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
